reason: I'm not putting a pre-SOC 2 startup with no customers inline on our order path, and our vendor risk team wouldn't let me. The agent identity check also rests on a passport registry the vendor's own founder started, and that's exactly what an examiner would pull apart.
objection: Why would I trust an identity registry the vendor's founder started? If the identity layer and the gate come from the same people, the 'tamper-evident evidence' is the vendor grading its own homework. And no examiner has asked us about AI agent controls yet, so this doesn't make next year's budget.
would_change_my_mind: A FINRA exam letter or sweep that asks how we govern customer AI agents, together with a finished SOC 2 Type II and agent identity standards run by an independent body, not the founder.
